prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop web decision comp, first viewport only, 1440x900 landscape 16:10.
Primary request: Design one finished product UI for Market Mate in the Authority Topography direction. This is an owner-only, display-only, read-only supervisory interface for an autonomous trading system. It must look operational and implementation-ready, not a concept poster.
Surface structure, in order: a slim top system strip; one dominant full-screen operational map centered on a large clearly bounded TRUST ZONE; surrounding contiguous territories labeled ATTENTION, PERFORMANCE, CAPITAL, and EVIDENCE; a continuous inspectable history trail crossing the terrain; compact coordinate/status stamps and drill-down affordances embedded at territory edges. Keep heads-up context visible as if a territory can open without replacing the map.
Current product truth to show verbatim and legibly: MARKET MATE; OWNER VIEW · DISPLAY ONLY; STAGE 1 · LOCAL_RESEARCH; ZERO ORDER AUTHORITY; CHECKPOINTS VERIFIED; QUALIFICATION PASSED; OPERATING COSTS OVER CAP; 2 EVIDENCE CYCLES; READ-ONLY SUPERVISORY INTERFACE. Execution environment must remain explicit and never imply Paper or Live execution.
Data content may use only these bounded internal states, with no invented returns, prices, dates, benchmarks, customers, testimonials, or external claims. Show trust/safety, attention, after-cost performance, cash/capital, costs, evidence freshness, and drill-down affordances simultaneously. For after-cost performance, use restrained labels such as AFTER-COST PERFORMANCE · INSPECT EVIDENCE without fabricating a number. For capital, use CAPITAL LEDGER · PRESERVED without fabricating a dollar amount. For evidence, use FRESHNESS · 2 CYCLES and inspectable lineage marks.
Critical visual event: one immediately visible red contour labeled exactly COST OVER CAP cuts through the map and dominates by scale before color; urgency changes scale before color. OPERATING COSTS OVER CAP appears as the primary attention state. Do not rely on red alone.
Style/medium: premium dark operational cartography interface combining a survey map, plotting table, and transparent heads-up operational overlays. Finished high-density product UI, precise grid, crisp microtypography, etched contour lines, measured coordinate notation, plot ticks, index marks, evidence trail nodes, subtle translucent panels integrated into the map rather than generic floating cards.
Composition/framing: straight-on browserless desktop viewport, edge-to-edge application, no device mockup, no perspective, no empty margins. Trust Zone occupies the visual center and largest territory. Attention territory upper-left or left edge with oversized over-cap contour. Performance and Capital flank the lower field; Evidence occupies the right field with a vertical inspectable lineage trail. Preserve global context while suggesting a selected territory through a transparent plotting overlay.
Color palette: background #0B1110, survey-paper text and linework #E7E0CF, calm cyan #8FBFC0, verified acid-lime #C8F26B, alert red-orange #F05A47. Use exact palette character with accessible contrast.
Materials/textures: dark survey paper, etched contour lines, translucent plotting-film overlays, coordinate stamps, dry technical ink, subtle tactile grain. No photorealism.
Typography: condensed technical grotesk plus small monospaced coordinate labels; exact labels must be readable, correctly spelled, and hierarchy-led. Strong numeral-free status labels are acceptable where product numbers are unavailable.
Constraints: owner-only; display-only; read-only; zero order authority; no buttons that trade, approve, execute, submit, or change state; drill-down affordances must read as inspect/trace/view only; never imply dashboard control authority. Show a persistent authority boundary legend distinguishing Incubator (discovery, zero authority), Sentinel (deterministic enforcement), and Engine (orchestration, cannot manufacture authority), using concise non-claiming labels.
Avoid: moodboard, wireframe, illustration, generic cards, generic fintech dashboard, map-themed skin, geographic continents, satellite imagery, literal city map, trading terminal clichés, candlestick hero charts, glossy gradients, neon cyberpunk, decorative charts without lineage, marketing copy, slogans, prices, P&L claims, returns, dates, fabricated metrics, testimonials, logos beyond the plain MARKET MATE wordmark, order-entry controls, approval controls, rounded card chrome, browser frame, perspective mockup, illegible pseudo-text, watermarks.
